mapper.select: SELECT am.AUTHORITY_ID, am.MENU_ID, am.READ_YN, am.CREATE_YN, am.UPDATE_YN, am.DELETE_YN, am.APPROVE_YN, am.CREATE_DT, am.UPDATE_DT, am.CREATE_ID, am.UPDATED_ID, am.DEL_YN, m.MENU_NAME FROM T3000_AUTHORITY_MENU am JOIN T3000_MENU m ON am.MENU_ID = m.MENU_ID WHERE am.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT am.AUTHORITY_ID, am.MENU_ID, am.READ_YN, am.CREATE_YN, am.UPDATE_YN, am.DELETE_YN, am.APPROVE_YN, am.CREATE_DT, am.UPDATE_DT, am.CREATE_ID, am.UPDATED_ID, am.DEL_YN, m.MENU_NAME FROM T3000_AUTHORITY_MENU am JOIN T3000_MENU m ON am.MENU_ID = m.MENU_ID WHERE am.AUTHORITY_ID = #{authorityId} AND am.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T3000_AUTHORITY_MENU ( AUTHORITY_ID, MENU_ID, READ_YN, CREATE_YN, UPDATE_YN, DELETE_YN, APPROVE_YN, CREATE_DT, CREATE_ID, DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{authorityId}, #{menuId}, #{readYn}, #{createYn}, #{updateYn}, #{deleteYn}, #{approveYn}, SYSDATE, #{createId}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE T3000_AUTHORITY_MENU SET READ_YN = #{readYn}, CREATE_YN = #{createYn}, UPDATE_YN = #{updateYn}, DELETE_YN = #{deleteYn}, APPROVE_YN = #{approveYn}, UPDATE_DT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_ID = #{updatedId} WHERE AUTHORITY_ID = #{authorityId} AND MENU_ID = #{menuId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
